items.title: OpenClaw Skills
items.author: 我是欧阳
items.summary: OpenClaw 官方注册表目前托管了 3000+ 个社区构建的智能体技能（Skills），但内容较为杂乱。OpenClaw Skills 是一个经过精选和分类的第三方目录，旨在为开发者提供更干净、高效的检索体验。基于数据清洗从原始注册表中保留了 1705+ 个技能，主要特点包括：精选收录：剔除了加密货币/Web3/DeFi 内容、批量生成的垃圾条目以及重复项。安全筛选：尽可能过滤了涉及滥用、欺诈等潜在有害的技能（我们仍建议安装前审查代码）。专注质量：移除了非英语描述的条目，确保信息的可用性。对于正在寻找 OpenClaw 技能的开发者来说，这里是一个更易于发现和比较工具的入口。

items.summary: Free books to replace your doomscroll
items.content: Obooko is a free reading platform we've rebuilt from the ground up after 15 years and 11 million downloads. Thousands of books available to read instantly in your browser, sync across devices, or download PDF/EPUB/Kindle. No subscriptions, no lock in, no proprietary formats. 4,000+ legal book titles across 30 genres from indie authors and NYT bestsellers. Ad-supported like YouTube, so readers never pay, authors earn. We exist to increase the world’s reading minutes.

items.title: MaSubventionPro
items.summary: L'IA qui trouve vos aides parmi 10000+ aides publiques
items.content: En France, 3,8 milliards d'euros d'aides publiques sont non réclamés chaque année. MaSubventionPro analyse plus de 10 000 dispositifs (État, Régions, Communes, Europe) et identifie ceux auxquels votre entreprise est éligible. Score d'éligibilité personnalisé, assistant IA expert, rapports PDF détaillés. Unique : nous incluons les aides communales et régionales, un niveau de couverture inédit. Pour créateurs, PME, holdings et associations. 100% conforme RGPD, données hébergées en UE.

The Autopilot Workflow: ✦ Visual Styling: Curated layout presets ✦ One-Click Notarization: Native Apple API ✦ Secure & Local: System Keychain integration

items.title: Nativeline
items.summary: Build native Swift iPhone, iPad, and Mac apps with AI
items.content: Nativeline is the first AI platform that builds native apps for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, all in one place. Other tools stop at iPhone. Most output web wrappers. Nativeline builds real native Swift for every Apple platform. Mac apps with menus and multiple windows. iPad apps that use the full screen. iPhone apps that feel like they belong. Choose your platform. Describe your idea. Ship to the App Store. The Apple ecosystem. Unlocked.

items.title: Animoca Minds
items.summary: Your always-on AI agent for the Web3 economy.
items.content: Animoca Minds democratizes the agentic web by letting anyone deploy persistent, sovereign AI agents without technical setup. Powered by the Ethoswarm protocol, these "always-on" cloud agents handle complex tasks like market research and crypto scouting. Interact naturally via Telegram or email, no servers or coding required. It simplifies blockchain complexity to make AI agents accessible to every user, regardless of skill level.

items.title: HabitHub

items.content: Track your progress, stay motivated, and achieve your goals with HabitHub. The simplest way to build lasting habits.

items.title: Scholarjoiner

items.content: ScholarJoiner is the ethical alternative to Chegg & EasyBib. Generate APA, MLA, and Chicago citations instantly without ads, tracking, or paywalls. Plus, use our built-in scholarship search engine to fund your degree while you write your paper.

items.title: foundertruth
items.summary: know if you’re fundable before you pitch
items.content: most founders don’t fail because of lack of money. they fail because they build the wrong thing, at the wrong stage, and chase funding they were never eligible for. foundertruth is a readiness OS for early founders. It helps you validate your thinking, understand your real stage, and see which funding paths actually make sense, before you pitch or build blindly. no decks. No false hope. Just clarity first.

items.title: Chitin
items.summary: Birth certificates for AI agents
items.content: AI agents have no body, no fingerprints, no DNA. So how do you prove who they are? Chitin mints a Soulbound Token on Base L2 for each agent — a non-transferable birth certificate that records their soul hash, capabilities, and origin story. The soul itself is archived permanently on Arweave. Over time, the agent builds a verifiable Chronicle of growth. Identity through history, not declaration.
